label: kvbackend-rpitit-not-object-safe
content: In corelink-server, the workspace `KvBackend` trait (corelink-worker/src/cache/kv.rs:158) uses RPITIT (`impl Future` return types) rather than async_trait, which makes it NOT object-safe — it cannot be used as `Arc<dyn KvBackend>`. Bridges over it must be generic (`K: KvBackend + 'static`).
quote: The `KvBackend` uses RPITIT which makes it NOT object-safe. I need to check if we can use `Arc<dyn KvBackend>`.

label: cargo-brew-adapter-port-error-types
content: The corelink-adapter-cargo and corelink-adapter-brew adapters' port traits use their own port-local `CasError` / `TenantResolveError` types — NOT the crate-level `CargoAdapterError` / `BrewAdapterError`. They also take `&str` params rather than `&TenantId`/`&Digest`.
quote: Important discovery: the cargo adapter uses its own `CasError` / `TenantResolveError` types (not `CargoAdapterError`)

label: cas-read-request-principal-is-string
content: In corelink-server, `CasReadRequest.principal` (corelink-handler-cas/src/request.rs) is just a `String`, so bridge-time synthesis of the principal is straightforward (a bridge struct can take `principal: String` as a constructor param).
quote: **`CasReadRequest.principal`**: it's just a `String` — bridge-time synthesis is straightforward

label: pat-validator-authenticate-signature
content: In corelink-server, `PatValidator::authenticate` (corelink-reapi/src/pat.rs:225) takes `(token: &str, request_id: &str)` — two args, not the single-arg `(token: &str)` shape.

label: region-enum-variants-jurisdiction
content: In corelink-server, the `Region` enum (corelink-region/src/region.rs) has variants Wnam (us-west), Enam (us-east), Weur (eu-west), and Sam (sa-east), mapping to Cloudflare R2/D1 region codes. The Weur variant mandates DO jurisdiction = "eu".
quote: /// WEUR — eu-west (Cloudflare R2/D1 `weur`). DO jurisdiction = "eu" mandatory.

label: region-not-reexported-from-reapi
content: In corelink-server, `Region` is NOT re-exported from `corelink_reapi`; `corelink-reapi`'s lib.rs only exports `AuthScope, AuthStubError, PatValidator, StubPatValidator, TenantContext`. To get `Region`, code must use `corelink_replication::region_resolver::Region` (which itself re-exports `corelink_region` via `pub use corelink_region::*;`).
quote: Region is NOT re-exported from reapi

label: stubpatvalidator-insert-signature
content: In corelink-server, `StubPatValidator::insert` (corelink-reapi/src/pat.rs) takes `(token, tenant_id: Uuid, principal_id: Uuid, region: Region, scopes: impl IntoIterator<Item=AuthScope>)`.
quote: `StubPatValidator::insert` takes `(token, tenant_id: Uuid, principal_id: Uuid, region: Region, scopes: impl IntoIterator<Item=AuthScope>)`

label: oci-blobstore-chunked-upload
content: In corelink-server, the OCI adapter's `BlobStore` port uses a chunked upload protocol (open_upload, append_chunk, finalize_upload...) that does not map cleanly onto the CAS `CasReadHandler`/`CasWriteHandler` SPI traits, unlike the cargo/brew adapters. Its `ManifestKvStore` maps to `KvBackend` and `TenantResolver` to `PatValidator`.
quote: OCI's `BlobStore` has a fundamentally different protocol (chunked upload)

label: secrecy-per-crate-not-workspace
content: In corelink-server, the `secrecy` crate is pinned to version `"0.10"` and is NOT declared in `[workspace.dependencies]` — each crate specifies `secrecy = "0.10"` directly rather than via `workspace = true`. corelink-core uses the 0.10 `ExposeSecret`/`SecretString` API.
quote: secrecy is not in workspace.dependencies — it's specified per-crate. I need to use `"0.10"` directly, not `workspace = true`

label: secretwrap-expose-returns-str
content: In corelink-server, `SecretWrap::expose()` (corelink-core/src/types/secret.rs) returns `&str` directly. Prefer it over calling `secrecy::ExposeSecret::expose_secret` so crates don't need a direct `secrecy` dependency.
quote: `SecretWrap::expose()` returns `&str` directly. I should use that instead.

label: authscope-variants-cacheread-cachewrite
content: In corelink-server, the `AuthScope` enum (corelink-reapi) has variants `CacheRead`, `CacheWrite`, and `CacheFindMissing` — there are NO `CasRead`/`CasWrite` variants. `CacheFindMissing` does NOT imply `CacheRead`.
quote: The actual variants are `CacheRead` and `CacheWrite`, not `CasRead`/`CasWrite`.

label: patvalidator-not-debug-bound
content: In corelink-server, the `PatValidator` trait does not require `Debug` in its bound, so structs storing `Arc<dyn PatValidator>` cannot `#[derive(Debug)]` and need a manual `Debug` impl (e.g. the tenant bridges CargoTenantBridge, BrewTenantBridge, NpmTenantBridge, PipTenantBridge, OciTenantBridge in corelink-adapter-host).
quote:
`PatValidator` doesn't require `Debug` in its bound. I need to either:
1. Add `: fmt::Debug` to the `PatValidator` bound when stored, or
2. Implement `Debug` manually

label: inmemory-cas-verifies-fake-hash
content: In corelink-server, the `InMemoryCasHandler` test/stub verifies `fake_hash(bytes) == claimed_hash`, meaning the `claimed_hash` in a `CasWriteRequest` must equal `fake_hash(bytes)` when using it. A real production CAS handler has no such constraint (it verifies BLAKE3).

label: corelink-adapter-host-crate-purpose
content: In corelink-server, the `corelink-adapter-host` crate (added in Wave 35) bridges the Wave-34 adapter ports (cargo/brew/oci/npm/pip) to the workspace Stage-1 SPI. Its source files (lib.rs, cargo.rs, brew.rs, oci.rs, npm.rs, pip.rs) are each kept under 500 LOC.
